lines.say: The man who said I would die called me again.
I answered. The old man's voice shook.
Every year, they make one copy of one worker.
The copy goes home. The original goes to Room Four.
Tell me one thing only you know, he said.
No. Whatever you say, the copy already has.
Inside, the man at my table stood up.
He walked to the front door. And opened it.
